items.exampleEn: The rules were changed in light of complaints from customers.
items.exampleZh: 鑑於顧客的抱怨，規定已經修改了。

items.exampleEn: Many changes followed in the wake of the report.
items.exampleZh: 那份報告公布之後，接連出現了許多改變。

items.exampleEn: Scientists are making a case for protecting the old forest.
items.exampleZh: 科學家們正在為保護那片老森林提出論據。

items.exampleEn: Farmers are struggling to meet demand for fresh eggs.
items.exampleZh: 農民們很難滿足市場對新鮮雞蛋的需求。

items.exampleEn: One journalist raised a question about the cost of the project.
items.exampleZh: 一位記者提出了一個關於這項計畫費用的問題。

items.exampleEn: Reaching a consensus is never easy in a big family.
items.exampleZh: 在大家庭裡，要達成共識從來都不容易。

items.sentenceEn: Her report raises a question about safety.
items.sentenceZh: 她的報告提出了一個關於安全的問題。

items.audioEn: We've hired ten more bakers this month to meet demand before the holidays.
items.audioZh: 我們這個月多請了十位烘焙師傅，以滿足假期前的需求。
items.questionZh: 為什麼這個月多請了十位烘焙師傅？
options: Because some workers are leaving soon
To open a second bakery next year

items.sentenceEn: The two countries failed to reach a consensus on fishing rights.
items.sentenceZh: 兩國未能就捕魚權達成共識。

items.sentenceEn: In light of recent events, the trip has been canceled.
items.sentenceZh: 鑑於最近發生的事，這趟旅行取消了。

items.stemEn: ____ the new tax, many small shops raised their prices.
items.stemZh: 新稅制實施之後，許多小商店都漲價了。

items.stemEn: In her speech, she tried to ____ building more bike lanes.
items.stemZh: 她在演講中試著為增建腳踏車道提出論據。

items.passageEn: Last month, our school held a public meeting on whether students should still wear uniforms. In light of rising costs for families, several parents made a case for allowing ordinary clothes. A teacher then raised a question that nobody else had considered: would students who could not afford fashionable clothes feel left out? After two hours of discussion, the meeting reached a consensus to keep uniforms but offer them at a lower price. In the wake of the decision, a local shop agreed to sell them without making a profit.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們學校舉辦了一場公開會議，討論學生是否還要穿制服。鑑於家庭開銷增加，好幾位家長主張讓學生穿一般的衣服。接著，一位老師提出一個大家都沒想到的問題：買不起時髦衣服的學生，會不會覺得被冷落？經過兩個小時的討論，會議達成共識：保留制服，但用較低的價格提供。這個決定公布之後，當地一家商店同意以不賺錢的價格販售制服。

questions.questionZh: 家長為什麼主張讓學生穿便服？
options: 附近的商店不賣制服了

questions.questionZh: 會議最後的決定是什麼？
options: 冬天可以穿自己的外套
由家長自己決定穿什麼

items.promptZh: 這本新書賣得太好，出版社印的量無法滿足需求。
referenceEn: The new book sold so well that the publisher couldn't print enough copies to meet demand.
The new book is selling so well that the publisher can't meet demand.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「滿足需求」（例如 to meet demand 等；meet the demand、meet demands 也正確）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 keep up with demand、satisfy demand 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 couldn't、can't 等）
「印的量」可寫，例如 print enough copies 等

items.promptZh: 鑑於這個新資訊，我們應該改變計畫。
referenceEn: In light of this new information, we should change our plan.
We should change the plan in light of this new information.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「鑑於」（例如 in light of this new information 等；in the light of 也正確）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 given、considering、in view of this new information 等）
「應該」可寫，例如 should、ought to 等
「計畫」可寫，例如 our plan、the plan 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：glossZh 第一義為「提出問題」（有人提問），但例句 The strange result raised a question for the researchers 示範的是「引發疑問」義（exampleZh 也譯成「讓研究人員產生了一個疑問」），沒有示範第一義。建議換成人當主詞的例句，如 A student raised a question about the homework.，或將 glossZh 改為「提出／引發疑問」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：例句改為 "One journalist raised a question about the cost of the project."（中譯「一位記者提出了一個關於這項計畫費用的問題。」），示範第一義「提出問題」
